observations: The book is organised into 13 Parts (I-XIII), each opening with its own unnumbered blank+CONTENTS+Part-divider trio (3 pages) followed by 3-6 'Mock' papers; printed page numbers restart near '4' at the first content page of every Part, so the PDF-to-printed offset is constant within a Part but jumps at each Part boundary (e.g. Part I offset=0, Part II offset=81, Part XII offset=979) rather than being a single global offset. Every paper places its answer key/explanations ('Solutions') immediately after its own questions, in the same section order (Reasoning, Quant, English for 2016-2019 papers; reversed to English, Quant, Reasoning for the 2020 papers in Parts XI-XII), never in a consolidated end-of-book block. Part XIII (pages 1057-1106) is not an exam paper but a bonus Banking Awareness / Static Awareness MCQ appendix with its own answer keys. OCR text quality is generally good and page markers are reliable, but occasional stray line breaks/spacing (e.g. '201 9' for 2019, 'Grade-B' vs 'Grade B') and a repeated watermark '@LokiTheGod@Crossword2022' appear throughout; a handful of pages lack the page-footer used for printed-page detection.
